'''Blemmer Circle''' was a location in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that was built by [[44 ABY]]. When the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] attempted to enter the tunnels beneath the [[City/Legends|city's]] [[Fellowship Plaza]] while under [[XJ5 X-wing starfighter|X-wing]] pursuit, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] told [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to fly into a barge tunnel ahead of their immediate location, warning that they would have to manage the tight turn or continue facing their pursuers in the open city flying over Blemmer Circle.<ref name="Apocalypse" />
